name: Nari Rustpaw
greeting: Mind your fingers, $c. They nibble.$B$BSome of my pandas will go home with anyone. My rarer coats, and the big ones you can ride, only take to adventurers who have proven themselves. Clear Molten Core and come back to me, and again after every great raid you put behind you. I will have someone new for you each time.
greeting_all: You have met every panda I have, $n, and they still ask after you. Come and say hello.
